drills.title: Clip the gradients, then AdamW (three steps; gradient norms 50, 0.5, 0.5)
drills.torch:
p = torch.zeros(2, requires_grad=True); opt = torch.optim.AdamW([p], lr=1e-3)
for g in ([30.0, 40.0], [0.3, 0.4], [0.3, 0.4]):
    p.grad = torch.tensor(g)
    nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_([p], 1.0); opt.step()
out = p

cands.code:
tx = optax.chain(optax.adamw(1e-3), optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0))
p = jnp.zeros(2); s = tx.init(p)
for g in ([30.0, 40.0], [0.3, 0.4], [0.3, 0.4]):
    u, s = tx.update(jnp.array(g), s, p); p = optax.apply_updates(p, u)
out = p
cands.why: clips Adam's updates instead of the gradients: Adam's second moment remembers the norm-50 gradient and shrinks the next steps
